lines.en: I walk the rooftops by moonlight.
My shadow moves first, then I follow.
One step in the mist closes a dozen yards.
I hug the wall without a sound.

lines.zh: 谁在我背后喊名字，我不回头。
lines.en: Someone calls my name behind me, I do not turn.
You won't hear my wooden sandals.

lines.zh: 夜里走路，灯笼自己跟着。
lines.en: Walking at night, a lantern follows on its own.

lines.zh: 我绕过神社，不想惹麻烦。
lines.en: I skirt the shrine to avoid trouble.

lines.zh: 你听见了吗，那是我在走。
lines.en: Did you hear that? It was me walking.
I stride across two patches of shadow.

lines.zh: 村口的狗对我叫，我不理。
lines.en: The village dog barks at me, I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我走在雨里，衣服却是干的。
lines.en: I walk in the rain with dry clothes.

lines.zh: 我站在你窗外，什么也不做。
lines.en: I stand at your window and do nothing.
Counting the night bells, I grow bored.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体长一截。
lines.en: My shadow is longer than my body.
I reach out and touch only wind.
The lamp went out, and I still stay.

lines.zh: 我在想，妖怪需要睡觉吗。
lines.en: I wonder whether youkai need sleep.

lines.zh: 有人在供桌上放了点心。
lines.en: Someone left sweets on the offering table.
I do not eat, but I accept the gift.

lines.zh: 我的袖子里什么也没有。
lines.en: There is nothing inside my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我听见你心跳，比鼓还响。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, louder than a drum.
I brought this fog with me.

lines.zh: 我数着檐下的雨滴发呆。
lines.en: I count raindrops under the eaves and drift.

lines.zh: 名字被人念多了，就会来。
lines.en: When my name is spoken enough, I appear.

lines.zh: 我不想动，动一下就有声音。
lines.en: I do not want to move, moving makes noise.
I fold my hands in my sleeves and wait.
The ash on the offering table has gone cold.
The lantern finds me, and I don't hide.
I have stood behind you for a long time.
Do not turn around, hear me first.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Your shoulders are shaking, I can see.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼睛比夜色更黑。
lines.en: I look up, my eyes blacker than the night.

lines.zh: 我们是不是在哪儿见过。
lines.en: Have we not met somewhere before?
The lamp in your hand cannot reach me.
I tilt my head and copy your expression.

lines.zh: 你数得清我几根手指吗。
lines.en: Can you count how many fingers I have?

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，你就退一点。
lines.en: I lean closer, and you lean away.

lines.zh: 优昙花的香味，你身上有。
lines.en: You carry the scent of udumbara.
Tea steam drifts over, and I know you.
Your light is on me. I don't move.
Walking at night, don't look back at me.

lines.zh: 这具身体，本来就不是我的。
lines.en: This body was never mine to begin with.
That one tickled a little.
A bit of my shape came apart.
Not iron, it is far too loud.
I step back, and the fog thins.
Pain is a word humans use.
You only cut my shadow.
I'll remember this debt in the night.
I retreat into the wall to catch my breath.
You are bolder than you look.
Are those dumplings for me?

lines.zh: 你念了我的名字，我就来了。
lines.en: You spoke my name, so I came.
The smell of sake slips under the door.

lines.zh: 我怕的是没人相信我在。
lines.en: What I fear is no one believing I exist.
A small offering is enough, I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 那扇门没关，是在请我吗。
lines.en: That door is open, is it inviting me?
I smell fear, and it tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 月光落在你肩上，我想碰。
lines.en: Moonlight rests on your shoulder, I want to touch it.

lines.zh: 给我讲个故事，我就留下。
lines.en: Tell me a story and I will stay.

lines.zh: 你答应过的事，我还记着。
lines.en: I still remember what you promised me.
You walked into me, cold, is it not?

lines.zh: 我身上没有重量，你却站不稳。
lines.en: I have no weight, yet you lose your footing.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的影子绊了你。
lines.en: Sorry, my shadow tripped you.

lines.zh: 我们擦肩而过，你打了个寒战。
lines.en: We brushed past, and you shivered.

lines.zh: 碰到我的地方会凉一整夜。
lines.en: Where you touched me stays cold all night.
What you bumped into was a layer of fog.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，我只是站着。
lines.en: I did not mean it, I was only standing.

lines.zh: 你一退，撞上了我的袖子。
lines.en: You stepped back and hit my sleeve.
Do not come too close, I carry a charge.

lines.zh: 撞完你，我消失了一会儿。
lines.en: After bumping you, I vanish for a moment.

lines.zh: 两个影子叠在一起，就是一对。
lines.en: Two shadows overlapping make a pair.

lines.zh: 我们在雾里交换了名字。
lines.en: We traded names inside the fog.
She smiled, and the lamps went out.
I keep watch over this well for her.

lines.zh: 妖怪的结合，不需要见证人。
lines.en: A youkai union needs no witnesses.

lines.zh: 她走过的地方，草都朝北倒。
lines.en: Where she walks, the grass bends north.

lines.zh: 我们一起数了一夜的星。
lines.en: We counted stars for a whole night.
She loves the human world; I love her.
Our shadows never come apart.

lines.zh: 这一夜很长，够我们说很多。
lines.en: This night is long enough for many words.
I straightened your shoes for you.
I will keep this copper coin for you.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片落叶，又放回去。
lines.en: I pick up a leaf and put it back.
Things grow lighter in my hands.

lines.zh: 我拿起灯笼，火苗变蓝了。
lines.en: I lift the lantern and its flame turns blue.
Whose clothes are these, left behind?
I folded the talisman into a paper crane.
Here, this is what you dropped.
I touched the blade and it rusted.

lines.zh: 口袋里的糖，我拿走一颗。
lines.en: I take one candy from your pocket.

lines.zh: 那个不信邪的人，我选他。
lines.en: That skeptic, I choose him.
You've stepped inside my circle.
Tonight's prey walks very slowly.
It is your shadow I have marked.
Whoever sees me first runs first.
You carry the smell of mortal rice.
I set my eyes on the one alone.
The lamps are out, so it is my turn.
I wait for the twelfth stroke of the bell.
The target moves, and so do I.
My face changes; you can't remember it.
I have written down your name.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，雾也跟着浓。
lines.en: I close in, and the fog thickens with me.
Back into the corner and there is no way out.
I know this alley blindfolded.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经围住你了。
lines.en: My shadow has already surrounded you.
Listen, footsteps come from every side.
The hand on your blade is sweating.
You grip your blade, and I am pleased.
Do not look behind me, no one is there.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经碰到你影子。
lines.en: My fingers have touched your shadow.
The more afraid you are, the closer I get.
Tonight I have plenty of patience.
I have hidden the way out.
Count to three, and I will begin.
My nails are colder than any blade.
This swipe passes straight through you.
Five white marks appear on your skin.
I do not bleed; you do.

lines.zh: 被打中的人会忘记我的脸。
lines.en: Whoever I strike forgets my face.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过了你的肩膀。
lines.en: My hand passed through your shoulder.
Does it hurt? I would like to know.

lines.zh: 一下就够了，不用第二下。
lines.en: One strike is enough, no second needed.

lines.zh: 我不是用力，我是在收魂。
lines.en: I am not striking hard, I am collecting souls.
The way you fall is very quiet.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，我睁开眼睛。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks and I open my eyes.
I grow out of the crack in the wall.
When the night thickens, I appear.
No drops, and no place I came from.
I am the one who blew out that lamp.

lines.zh: 我站在村口，等第一个夜归人。
lines.en: I stand at the gate awaiting the first late walker.

lines.zh: 世上又多了一个说不清的东西。
lines.en: The world gained one more unexplainable thing.
When I was born, the house was empty.
The fog cleared, and here I am.
Do not ask me where I came from.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落地，我才落地。
lines.en: My shadow lands first, then I land.

lines.zh: 神社的铃响了三下，我醒了。
lines.en: The shrine bell rang three times, and I woke.
I was born without a shadow.

lines.zh: 你要不要给我起个名字。
lines.en: Would you like to give me a name?
The fire is too bright for my eyes.

lines.zh: 落地时我散成了一片雾。
lines.en: On landing I scattered into mist.

lines.zh: 水里有东西拉着我往下。
lines.en: Something in the water pulls me down.
The blast splits me into two halves.

lines.zh: 妖怪的身子，被箭戳穿了。
lines.en: The arrow punched through this youkai body.
The talisman sticks and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我还是饿。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I still feel hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的轮廓很清楚。
lines.en: In the lightning, my outline is sharp.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连我也快没了。
lines.en: There is nothing here, even I am fading.
